author: olivierfevry
quote:
This game should have been called GTA Jason and Lucia in Vice city  not GTA 6, because it does not represent what GTA has always been, it s a SPIN OFF. 

The reason why a lot of people bought is because of the success of GTA5 and the expectations they had based on that and how funny, and fun the previous GTA's before GTA5 were. This game is not a true success and the 99/100 is surely inaccurate.
